newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech shares edge higher at PSE daily fixing.
newsitem.headline: Czech shares edge higher at PSE daily fixing.

text.p: Czech shares were slightly higher at the daily price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange on Tuesday, with rises to the market's three main issues pushing the bourse's indices higher.
SPT Telecom, CEZ and Komercni Banka all gained ground at the fixing to boost the Reuters RPIX index 3.6 points to 1,014.3 while the broader PX50 index edged up 2.9 points to 491.9.
"The fundamentals of the market have worsened and the effects of high interest rates will probably hit the bottom line of many companies," said Jan Sykora of Wood and Company.
Electrical utility Elektrarny Opatovice led net gainers on the PX50, rising 150 crowns to 4,400. Most other utilities were mixed.
